ev: Companion to BACKLOG B-056 (four owner rulings, honest cost) and B-055 (today's silence on a second directive); contract is PROP-035's #source mechanics and its no-deadlock invariant.

The pipeline takes the FIRST `#source` and drops the rest silently.
crates/vibe-spec/src/pipeline.rs:221 - `.find(|d| d.kind == DirectiveKind::Source).map(|d| d.address)`, read line by line
found: `find` returns the first match and the function returns one address; there is no diagnostic on a second directive. This is B-055's silence, stated as the basis rather than as a complaint.
